Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About Our Team

The Growth Platform team is the infrastructure squad for Growth at Scribd. We build the shared services and tooling that the other Growth teams build on, and we empower marketers, lifecycle teams, and partner channels by delivering MarTech solutions that drive efficiency, data-informed decisions, and scalable user acquisition across our brands: Scribd, Everand, Slideshare, and Fable.

Our work spans self-service tooling, experimentation infrastructure, acquisition tracking and attribution, and integrations that share customer and event data with third-party platforms. Because we're a platform team, a lot of what we build ships through other teams' products, so we care about reliability and scalability, and about making our systems easy for others to build on. The team values collaboration, pragmatic problem-solving, and a culture of technical excellence.

About The Role

We are seeking a determined Fullstack Software Engineer to join our Growth Platform team. In this role, you will design, build, and scale the shared systems that power Growth at Scribd, from self-service tooling and experimentation infrastructure to the data integrations behind our lifecycle marketing.

You will partner closely with marketers, data analysts, lifecycle teams, and the other Growth engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions that enhance cross-channel marketing effectiveness, attribution accuracy, and customer engagement. You’ll participate in technical design, code reviews, and best practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve systems and processes.

Key Areas Of Responsibility Include

Building intuitive, performant self-service tools that let marketers and other teams move without engineering help.
Building and maintaining integrations that share customer and event data with third-party platforms, including our lifecycle marketing tools.
Ensuring scalability, testability, and maintainability throughout the development process.
Collaborating across teams to drive impactful projects forward.
Staying proactive by proposing innovative solutions to technical challenges.

What We’re Looking For

A passionate engineer who takes pride in writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.
Someone who thrives in both backend system design and frontend feature development.
A strong communicator and collaborator who enjoys working with marketers, data scientists, product managers, and engineers across the Growth Pillar to develop high-leverage, self-service tools and data activation workflows.
An engineer who stays current with industry trends and technologies.
A pragmatic problem-solver who balances technical rigor with business needs.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of professional software development experience.
Proficiency with TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React.
Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and its ecosystem.
Understanding of database systems (SQL and NoSQL) and architectural tradeoffs.
Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL a plus).
Understanding of experimentation, A/B testing, personalization systems, and the MarTech landscape.
Communicates clearly and frequently with cross-functional partners, influencing through technical depth and collaborative decision-making.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Nice to Have

Experience with instrumenting and working on data integration projects, such as event tracking, data pipelines, or syncing user data between internal systems and third-party platforms.
Have worked in a Growth Engineering or Growth Platform team at a product-led company.
Experience with backend technologies like Redis, Kafka, MySQL, and Terraform.
Knowledge of GraphQL and Next.js.
Familiarity with migrating monolithic architectures to microservices/frontends.

Union Home Mortgage’s L.E.A.D Internship Program’s goal is to provide a fun, interesting, and real-world environment for our interns to Learn

Some of the programs we offer include: shadowing, mentoring, professional development, group projects and we even take our interns on corporate outings! Our internship program gives students a chance to meet new people, gain more experience, and learn from the best in the business! Our interns are treated like full-time Partners who work 40 hours a week during the 3-month summer program, are compensated, and based out of headquarters in Strongsville, Ohio.

The AI Software Engineer Intern works as part of a software development team to design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions that meet business and product needs.

This role represents the evolution of the traditional Software Developer Intern. The team follows established software development practices including Agile delivery, requirements and user stories, source control, peer review, testing, deployment processes, and architectural standards. However, AI-assisted development is expected to be a fundamental part of how modern software engineering is performed.

Interns will learn how to use AI development tools throughout the software development lifecycle to generate and modify implementations, create tests, troubleshoot problems, understand unfamiliar code, develop documentation, and improve existing solutions. At the same time, interns will develop the software engineering fundamentals necessary to critically evaluate what AI produces and ensure resulting software meets established standards.

The internship provides hands-on experience with both professional software engineering practices and the emerging AI-native tools that are changing how modern software is developed.

Duties & Responsibilities

Duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions with guidance from experienced software engineers.
Use AI-assisted development tools throughout the software development lifecycle.
Translate product requirements, user stories, designs, and technical requirements into functional software.
Use AI tools to assist with generating implementations, tests, documentation, troubleshooting approaches, and refactoring.
Learn to critically review and validate AI-generated software rather than accepting generated solutions without evaluation.
Develop and maintain applications, APIs, integrations, services, and data solutions using established technology standards.
Create and maintain unit and integration tests.
Enhance, maintain, and troubleshoot existing applications.
Participate in source control, pull requests, peer reviews, and established CI/CD processes.
Work with Product Owners, UI/UX Designers, senior engineers, QA resources, and other team members throughout the development lifecycle.
Participate in Agile activities including planning, estimation, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
Troubleshoot defects and learn how to identify appropriate solutions.
Follow established architectural, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability standards.
Explore emerging AI development capabilities and learn how they can be effectively incorporated into professional software engineering practices.

Qualifications

To perform this role successfully, an individual should demonstrate a strong interest in software engineering, foundational programming knowledge, problem-solving ability, and a desire to learn how AI is changing modern software development.

Skills Required

Passion for software development, technology, computer science, and AI.
Foundational understanding of programming and software development concepts.
Interest in AI-assisted software engineering and emerging development tools.
Ability and willingness to understand, evaluate, debug, and improve AI-generated code.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts.
Interest in APIs, databases, web applications, cloud technologies, and modern application architecture.
Ability to learn and follow established coding, architecture, security, and engineering standards.
Self-motivated with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to work both independently and collaboratively.
Strong desire to learn and adapt as software engineering practices continue to evolve.

Education & Experience

Pursuing a 4-year college degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Completion of programming coursework or equivalent hands-on development experience.
Experience with an object-oriented programming language through coursework or personal projects.
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools is preferred but not required.
Personal software projects, coursework, hackathons, or other examples of hands-on development are a plus.

Who Are We?

The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA.

Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users.

At Ditch Witch in Perry, Oklahoma we pride ourselves on being the leading manufacturer in the underground pipe and cable market. Our plant in Perry stands out because it's a place for people to learn and thrive. We enjoy coming to work because our plant is our community, we see our teammates not only as co-workers but as neighbors and family members. All of our locations build the intricate network of machinery that contributes to The Toro Company.

What Will You Do?

In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:

Gathering and analyzing technical data from diverse sources, including conversations with engineers, product managers, suppliers, technical documents, equipment operations and personal experiments.
Develop, debug, validate, and enhance embedded hardware, software, desktop applications, and mobile applications using advanced hardware and firmware design methodologies.
Create and debug prototypes to validate compliance with specifications.
Define measurement techniques, tuning procedures, and special test fixtures for production use.
Prepare comprehensive compliance and production documentation.

What Do You Need?

Enrolled in a Bachelor of Science or graduate program accredited in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or closely related engineering field.
If pursuing a bachelor’s degree, completion of at least sophomore year (60 or more credit hours).

Employee must have successfully completed courses in the following fields:

Mathematics – Calculus, Differential Equations
Science – General Physics
Engineering – Basic Circuit Analysis, Static Body Analysis
Computing – Minimum of 6 credit hours in modern computer programming languages (C, C++, C#, Python, Java, Pascal, or similar)
Understanding of the development of embedded hardware and firmware for 8/16/32-bit microcontrollers using C/C++ is preferred.
Understanding of the development of application software for embedded Linux systems is a plus.
Experience developing desktop applications in C# or Python is a plus.
Understanding of common communications schemes such as SPI, I2C, RS232, and CAN
Good oral and written communication skills.
Comfortable in a team environment.
Good problem-analysis and resolution skills.
Positive and energetic attitude.

Proficiency with TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern frameworks like React.
Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and its ecosystem.
Understanding of database systems (SQL and NoSQL) and architectural tradeoffs.
Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST, GraphQL a plus).
Understanding of experimentation, A/B testing, personalization systems, and the MarTech landscape.
Communicates clearly and frequently with cross-functional partners, influencing through technical depth and collaborative decision-making.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Experience with instrumenting and working on data integration projects, such as event tracking, data pipelines, or syncing user data between internal systems and third-party platforms.
Have worked in a Growth Engineering or Growth Platform team at a product-led company.
Experience with backend technologies like Redis, Kafka, MySQL, and Terraform.

Job Summary:
The Automation Engineer will be responsible for supporting, maintaining and developing automation control systems used throughout the rolling process. This role requires strong knowledge and experience in electrical and automation control systems such as PLC’s, HMI’s, drives, and VME controllers. The Automation Engineer will also participate in projects that require development, design and documentation of new or improved systems. The Automation Engineer must be highly motivated with excellent communication skills and be willing to provide technical assistance within a team environment.

Responsibilities

Troubleshoot, design and improve automation control systems in aluminum manufacturing facility.
Troubleshoot, maintain, and develop control system code relating to IEC 61131-3 (Ladder, Function Block, Structured Text, Instruction List, Sequential Function Charts)
Setup, commission and debug hardware and field instrumentation relating to the control systems.
Troubleshoot and support small to medium sized AC and DC drives.
Create or maintain intuitive and user-friendly HMI screens to interface with automation control systems.
Customize HMI applications to meet specific project requirements.
Interface and collaborate with area engineers from same or different disciplines to help resolve any process issues.
Setup, configure and maintain industrial communication networks (Profinet, Profibus, Modbus, OPC, Ethernet)
Participate in team-oriented projects while providing expertise in automation, leading to successful on-time project completion.
Participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) for new developments and projects.
Electronically document thorough detail on control system troubleshooting using change logs.
Perform routine backups of PLC and drive projects.
Interface 3rd party products to PLC’s and other control system hardware.
Effectively communicate with other team members on technical issues needing resolved to maintain a fluent manufacturing process.
Ensure any new automation control systems are designed to current industry and plant standards.
Provide troubleshooting assistance and leadership to area electricians or other maintenance personnel.
Demonstrate safe working practices.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Automation or a related field.
Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting Level 1 control systems in a manufacturing environment.
Experience programming, troubleshooting, and supporting PLC-based control systems utilizing IEC 61131-3 programming standards.
Understanding of industrial control systems, PLC hardware, and automation principles; exposure to Allen-Bradley, Siemens, and/or Modicon platforms preferred.
Working knowledge of electrical components and circuits, including relays, transformers, circuit breakers, contactors, and motor starters.
Experience working with industrial communication networks and protocols such as Profinet, Profibus, Modbus, TCP/UDP.
S trong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex control system issues.
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and apply engineering principles in a manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Five (5) or more years of experience supporting industrial automation and control systems in a manufacturing environment.
Experience designing, programming, and troubleshooting PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA systems.
Experience with machine safety systems, safety-rated controls, and Safety Integrity Level (SIL) standards.
Experience with industrial networking and communications architecture.
Experience leading or supporting automation improvement projects.
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.

Key Competencies

Ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across operations, maintenance, engineering, and IT teams.
Demonstrated commitment to workplace safety and safe work practices.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Willingness to provide occasional off-hours support through phone, VPN, and on-site troubleshooting as needed.

About Constellium

With over 1,200 employees, Constellium’s plant in Ravenswood, West Virginia, is one of the

world’s largest rolled products facilities, offering customers the most powerful plate stretchers in

the world, as well as one of the largest cold rolling mills. Built in 1957, the plant houses 62 acres

(about 250,900 m²) of production facilities and is one of the top 50 businesses in West Virginia.

We produce plate, sheet, and coil products for aerospace, defense, transportation, marine, and

industrial uses. As the global leader in aluminum aerospace technology, we specialize in high

performance plates, sheets, extrusions, and precision castings that bring cost benefits to space

programs and military and commercial aircraft. Our pre-machining and custom designed

components can be found in products for Airbus, Boeing, Bombardier, Lockheed Martin, NASA,

and others.

The Ravenswood facility is nestled in the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains, along the

Ohio River. It is the largest employer in Jackson County, and one of the top 50 businesses in

West Virginia.

A culture of family, community, and hard work runs deep in Jackson County. Located in the

western region of West Virginia is one of the most productive regions in the state, with Ripley

as its countyseat and Ravenswood serving as its largest municipality. Ripley sits between the

Parkersburg and Charleston metropolitan areas.

The region offers plenty of activities, both open-air and indoors, for a wide range of interests.

These include parks, lakes, forests, Civil War trails, golf courses, historical landmarks (covered

bridges, a heritage house, a castle), museums and galleries, conference centers, the Clay

Center for the Arts and Sciences, the Charleston Light Opera Guild, and much more.

Structured Learning includes semiconductor and system fundamentals; NXP product portfolios; embedded systems and software fundamentals; business fundamentals; and instructor-led training from NXP subject-matter experts and leaders.

On-the-Job Training includes working closely with experienced field application engineers, technical sales engineers (TSEs), technical product teams, NXP partners, as well as customers solving technical problems, support design-in activity and build deep applications knowledge.

Career Outcomes

Upon completion, participants transition into a permanent FAE role within the Americas Sales organization, with placement based on business needs and candidate preferences.

The FAE is our field specialist for critical technology functions – the experts! The FAE role is designed to provide the customer additional technical guidance on NXP solutions and when necessary – hands on technical support.

The FAE role specializes in a critical technology category such as Microcontrollers, Applications Processors, Wireless, Security, or Security. The FAE team will develop a tight relationship with the business line for their critical technology focal areas as a means of extra technical guidance and support.

FAEs aid the field team in the identification of new projects at their customers and work with the TSEs to propose a value based technical solution to their customer’s needs. The FAE also focuses on building trustworthy relationships with the customer by offering real-time technical support. Through offering real-time, trustworthy technical support to our customers – you will be directly contributing to NXP’s overall goal to grow revenue at your accounts/territory.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership to sales teams and customers covering NXP portfolio. Ex – MCU/MPU selection, bring-up, and software stack integration.
Lead proof of concept development, product evaluations, debug activities, integration efforts, lab validation and basic system-level troubleshooting using oscilloscopes, current/voltage probes, power analyzers, and software debug/trace tools.
Design support through schematic and PCB reviews
Prepare and deliver technical presentations, demonstrations and training materials with guidance from senior engineers
Collaborate with sales, marketing, product management and engineering teams to communicate customer needs and support business opportunities
Drive enablement initiatives by communicating customer feedback, identifying gaps in collateral, and partnering with product lines to improve tools, software, and documentation
Represent NXP technology at customer meetings, workshops, partner and industry activities

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or a related technical field
Graduate in past 24 months or upcoming graduate
Minimum GPA of 3.0 or higher
Passion for electronics, and embedded MCU/MPU software for robotics applications, including real-time control, motor control, sensor integration, edge AI, and Linux- or RTOS-based system development
Foundational understanding of analog and digital circuits, embedded systems, microcontrollers, processors, semiconductor applications, and software development skills in C, C++, Python, or similar languages
Familiarity with embedded debugging and development environments, including IDEs, SDKs, evaluation boards, and common lab tools
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly
Good written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain technical concepts to different audiences
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional, and customer-focused environment
Self-motivated, curious, and eager to develop both technical expertise and business acumen
Experience presenting technical work through class projects, internships, research, competitions, or student organizations
Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, or campus involvement through engineering teams, competitions, or technical societies
Internship, co-op, or project experience in applications engineering, design engineering, embedded software, technical sales, or customer support
Willingness to relocate to Austin and travel primarily within the North America

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

Exposure to embedded software development or debugging through academic or hands-on projects
